categories.main_business_segments: Forum Engineering Inc. operates primarily in the engineer staffing and placement business, with its core segment being engineer dispatch services, which accounted for 98.8% of sales in FY2025. The company also provides four 'Cognavi' branded services supporting all career stages of engineers, including new graduate placement, mid-career recruitment, and engineer training mediation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary AI-driven skill matching technology, embodied in its 'Cognavi' platform. This system uses structured 'technical trees' and 'skill trees' to visualize and match the skills of engineers with the requirements of client companies, enabling objective, data-driven direct matching. The platform incorporates natural language processing for automatic extraction and linking of technical terms, and offers features such as matching scores, matching maps, and chat-based communication.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Forum Engineering primarily serves large and mid-sized manufacturing companies in eight key machinery and electronics industries: automotive, transportation equipment, industrial machinery, precision instruments, electrical equipment, home appliances, electronic components, and information/communications. Its main customers are business units within these companies, especially those with over 100 employees, and it also targets engineering students and professionals seeking career advancement.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main operations are in Japan, with 16 domestic sales offices and a headquarters in Tokyo. Internationally, it has expanded into India through its subsidiary Cognavi India Private Limited, which operates a job portal and HR tech services tailored to the Indian market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Forum Engineering operates downstream in the human resources supply chain, acting as a service provider that connects engineering talent with end-user companies, primarily through staffing, placement, and training services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on enhancing engineer mobility and addressing structural engineer shortages through technology-driven matching and comprehensive career support. It prioritizes investment in ICT and AI for its matching platform, expansion of its 'Cognavi' services, and international growth, particularly in India. While it does not conduct traditional R&D, it invests in platform development and digital transformation to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from engineer dispatch (staffing) fees paid by client companies, with additional income from placement fees, training mediation, and, in India, job portal services. The company also receives fees for direct employment transfers of dispatched engineers and charges for job postings on its platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Forum Engineering is one of the leading players in Japan’s engineer staffing sector, competing with other large HR service providers and emerging HR tech firms. Its unique technology-driven matching model and focus on the machinery/electronics engineering segment differentiate it from traditional staffing agencies. The company faces competition from both established staffing firms and online recruitment platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, consolidated sales reached 34.7 billion yen (up 10.9% YoY), with operating profit of 4.2 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 2.88 billion yen. The company employs over 5,000 people and has shown strong growth in both revenue and profitability, driven by increased engineer placements and higher unit prices. It maintains a high equity ratio (68.8%) and robust cash position.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Forum Engineering’s value proposition lies in its proprietary AI-based skill matching platform, which enables precise, objective, and efficient matching of engineers to client needs. By visualizing skills and requirements, it reduces hiring mismatches and supports all stages of an engineer’s career. Its comprehensive service lineup, focus on stable employment for engineers, and ability to address structural talent shortages set it apart from competitors.
